action: Added a seventh guide, a seventh article treatment, and a puppy essentials tag

guide.title: A Puppy's First Six Months: What You Actually Need, and When
guide.shape: Arranged by when things become useful rather than as a checklist: before arrival, weeks 8-12, teething, handling, weeks 16-24, what gets replaced, what to skip, when it is a vet question
guide.pull_quote: Most puppy checklists are shopping lists with a paragraph on top.
argues_against_buying: Do not buy the proper bed yet - you cannot tell at ten weeks whether the dog curls or sprawls
Most young puppies do not need a slow feeder
Nothing sold to stop a puppy biting works - not sprays, gels or deterrents
Pads teach a puppy that indoors is sometimes acceptable, which you later have to undo
Starter bundles, teething gels and a second bed: skip
Diarrhoea, repeated vomiting, lethargy and a persistent cough are vet calls, and nothing on this site treats any of them

treatment.why: Written for a first-timer being sold thirty things they do not need, so the furniture is reassurance rather than authority
treatment.furniture: Oversized opening paragraph, section headings on a tinted band with an accent rule, table ruled only horizontally so it reads as a checklist
treatment.accent_note: Close to the beds guide's sage #4F6152. Sage is a grey-green for a guide about rest, olive a yellow-green for one about growth, and they are never on the same page.
treatment.design_doc: guidePrimer and guidePrimerDark added to DESIGN.md and the design re-saved and re-activated; check-design then passed with no violations

tag.name: Puppy essentials
tag.kept_out_of_the_problems_hub: lookdog_problem_terms() now requires lookdog_problem_order meta rather than accepting every product_tag. A life stage is not a problem, and listing it would put 'Puppy essentials' between 'Barking too much' and 'Chewing everything' as though it were something to fix.

no_reading_map_row: lookdog_reading_map is keyed by product_cat and every product already links to its category guide. Adding the puppy guide there would put two 'before you buy' links on 20 product pages selling the same article.

correction_to_the_readme.was: write-file truncates above roughly 10KB, so build guide content with execute-php closures
correction_to_the_readme.now: It does not. This guide went in as a single 12,525-byte write-file to a tmp- file in the sandbox, which execute-php then read, validated and published before deleting it.
